candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. Refresh tokens are tied to session rows, so an already signed-in device keeps a valid session and can still call refreshToken to renew its login. The password-change path in AuthService.update does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, but resetPassword has no equivalent call.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }). No session is excluded, because the reset request isn't authenticated.
